item.title: Read The Top News Headlines For Monday 12 January In One Click
item.description: Stay updated with the biggest headlines for Monday, 12 January- politics, crime, sports, and more - all summarized for quick reading. Get instant access to breaking news, major developments, and trending stories in just one click. Perfect for busy readers who want news on the go.

item.title: Gold slips marginally across major cities, Silver also down; Check latest rates here
item.description: Gold prices declined marginally today after a brief phase of stability, driven by profit booking in domestic markets. After a strong two-day rally, investors chose to lock in gains, leading to a mild correction in gold and silver rates.

item.title: German Chancellor to meet PM Modi; Rs 52,500-Crore Submarine deal in focus
item.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in India for a two-day visit and is set to meet Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Ahmedabad. Talks will focus on trade, investment, defence cooperation and advanced technology.

item.title: High alert in J&K after multiple Pakistani drone sightings near border
item.description: Security forces in Jammu and Kashmir were placed on high alert after multiple suspected Pakistani drones were sighted near the International Border and Line of Control in Samba, Rajouri and Poonch districts.

item.title: Sensex slides over 500 points at open, Nifty falls below 25,550; Key signals for investors
item.description: Indian equity benchmarks opened sharply lower as heavy selling dragged the Sensex down over 500 points, while Nifty 50 slipped below the 25,550 mark. Market volatility surged, with India VIX rising nearly 9 percent, reflecting investor nervousness.

item.title: From holy dips to high security; Magh Mela 2026 showcases spiritual grandeur
item.description: Magh Mela 2026 is in full swing in Prayagraj, with millions of devotees braving intense cold to take a holy dip at the Sangam. The 44-day spiritual fair features enhanced security, modern facilities and digital services.

item.title: ISRO PSLV-C62 Launch: Vehicle encounters path deviation; Detailed analysis initiated
item.description: "Performance of the vehicle up to the end of 3rd stage was as expected, then we saw more disturbance in vehicle's roll rates, subsequently there was a deviation observed in flight path."

item.title: Farmer Suicide Case: Dhami seeks transparent inquiry after farmer alleges police harassment
item.description: Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami has ordered a magisterial inquiry into the suicide of Kashipur farmer Sukhwant Singh, who died by shooting himself in a Haldwani hotel room.

item.title: Golden Globes Awards 2026: Leonardo DiCaprio’s film shines big; Full winners list and key highlights
item.description: The Golden Globe Awards 2026 were held at the Beverly Hilton in California, celebrating excellence in film and television. One Battle After Another, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, emerged as the biggest winner, securing top honours including Best Director and Screenplay.

item.title: Amazon Great Republic Day Sale 2026: Huge discounts on smartphones; Check here
item.description: Amazon Great Republic Day Sale 2026 starts on January 16, offering massive discounts on popular smartphones. Samsung Galaxy A55 5G, iQOO Z10R 5G, and OnePlus 15R are among the top deals, with savings up to ₹2,999.
